title: domain-mapping-guidance/<framework>.json
description: Per-domain, per-objective mapping guidance for a control framework (CCMv4 today; NIST/CIS/ISO may be added as sibling files). Gives map-framework-mapping a focused per-domain context and supplies the applicability/accuracy validators their source of truth: each objective's intent, whether it is mappable for a platform/infrastructure service, and which mechanism classes may or must never satisfy it. allow_mechanisms / deny_mechanisms reference mechanism_classes keys.

mechanism_classes.description: Closed vocabulary of control mechanism classes. Keys are class ids referenced by allow_mechanisms / deny_mechanisms.

intent.description: What THIS objective actually requires — the discriminator that prevents keyword mis-maps.

mappable.description: mappable: legitimately satisfiable by platform/infra config. default_na: N/A for a serverless/managed/infrastructure service unless overridden. conditional: mappable only when a genuine service capability backs it; an override is expected.

allow_mechanisms.description: mechanism_classes ids that legitimately satisfy this objective.

deny_mechanisms.description: mechanism_classes ids that must NEVER satisfy this objective (a control of this class mapped here is a mis-mapping).

na_reason.description: Canonical reason string when default_na — written into the mapping's reason when the objective stays N/A.

override_requires.description: Fields a MAPPED entry must carry to override a default_na/conditional objective (typically applicability_justification + reference_url).
